name: Minikko Half ~Naisho no Ano ne~
original_name: みにっ娘ハーフ ～ないしょのあのね～
source:
The protagonist Takejou Subaru lives a usual boring life, but one day he is offered a part-time job of the private tutor by his first love, who has just returned from the USA. His students are her daughters, half-blood twin sisters: Maria and Alice.

"A-ah, ni-nice to meet you" - those words spoken in basic Japanese, emerald eyes, and... blond hair! Those girls suddenly appeared before the hero's eyes just like perfect angels.

Or so it looked like... Maria-chan has an unexpected weakness: she is extremely sensitive to any touch. She becomes excited even by the slightest touch of a man. And now she's living under the same roof with one.

While doing his job as a tutor, the hero is ready to take care of her body and soul!

[Translated from [url=http://www.massel.jp/perle/minikko/story.html]Official site[/url]]
